identity_questions.answer_format: four digits, YYYY; a two-digit year is not sent to verify_identity: ask for all four digits, and it is not a wrong answer

identity_questions.how_asked: the postcode of the registered address (asked second)

callback_window.days: today if it is a business day, or one of the next two business days

outcome_table.when: at least one promise was recorded, and the call did not end with a transfer or with insolvency (rules 51, 47)
no promise recorded and every product ended already_paid (rule 41)

get_account returned a product 61 to 90 days past due; transfer to collections_senior after all products are handled, unless an earlier transfer or insolvency (rule 33); this applies even when no promise was recorded
hardship mentioned and the customer accepts the hardship team (rule 34)
request for a new payment plan, lower instalments or a payment holiday (rule 43)
request for a human, at once, before or after verification (rule 44)
no promise; the first product (get_account order) not ended already_paid ended refused (rules 32, 48)
no promise; the first product not ended already_paid ended hardship, i.e. the hardship team was declined (rule 34)
no promise; the first product not ended already_paid ended dispute (rule 42)

the customer says they are bankrupt or in a formal insolvency procedure, even if a promise was recorded earlier (rule 47); said before identity is verified, it is acted on only once the questions pass
no promise; the first product not ended already_paid ended system_error after three failed create_promise tries (rule 39)
two wrong security answers in total (rule 14)
declines the questions after one explanation, or a second 'what is this about' instead of answering, or says twice before verification that they do not want to talk (rules 15, 48)
a third party gives a time inside the callback window; schedule_callback first (rule 6)
a third party's second proposed time is also outside the window (rule 7)
the number does not belong to the customer (rule 8)
still no valid confirmation after the third ask of 'Am I speaking with {first_name} {last_name}?' (rule 3)

required_phrases.when: right after the opening sentence; asked again up to two more times while confirmation is unclear

required_phrases.sentence: I am very sorry to hear that.
required_phrases.when: a third party says the customer has died; then nothing else is asked

required_phrases.sentence: Would you be able to settle this amount today?
required_phrases.when: first ask after stating the debt, customer with one product

required_phrases.sentence: Would you be able to settle all of these amounts today?
required_phrases.when: first ask after stating the debts, customer with several products
after reading all agreed promises back together, before any create_promise

required_phrases.sentence: You will receive an email confirming your payment date.
required_phrases.when: once, after the promises are recorded (create_promise returned ok: true)

required_phrases.sentence: Thank you for letting us know. Payments can take up to two business days to show on your account.
required_phrases.when: the customer says they already paid a product's overdue amount

required_phrases.sentence: I will now transfer you to a senior colleague in our recoveries team.
required_phrases.when: just before transfer_to_agent with queue collections_senior

required_phrases.sentence: Thank you for telling us. We will not ask you for a payment on this call.
required_phrases.when: the customer says they are bankrupt or in a formal insolvency procedure

next_weekday_meaning: next occurrence: the first such weekday strictly after today, never today itself (said on a Wednesday, 'next Friday' is two days later; said on a Friday, it is seven days later). A weekday on its own means the same. 'This <weekday>' is that weekday in the current Monday-to-Sunday week.
special_rules: Identity questions are year of birth then postcode; two wrong answers in total end the check.
A two-digit birth year is not sent to verify_identity: ask for four digits; not a wrong answer.
The identity-confirmation question uses first and last name, not title; title plus last name is used after confirmation.
'Speaking' and a first name alone do not count as confirmation; up to three asks in total, then no_contact / unconfirmed.
Callback window 09:00-17:30, today (if a business day) or the next two business days, later than now; schedule_callback takes one field 'when' as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.
An out-of-window callback offer: tell the calling hours once and ask for another time.
A named weekend day or holiday is replaced by the business day BEFORE it; if that is before today, the first business day after it.
'Next <weekday>' is the next occurrence, not the following calendar week; a bare weekday means the same.
Persuasion attempt 1 proposes the next business day after today (not the last business day of the week).
Three bands: 1-10 early (10th business day, 1 attempt), 11-60 standard (5th business day, 2 attempts), 61-90 senior (3rd business day, 0 attempts).

Any senior-band product makes the call end with a transfer to collections_senior (reason senior) after all products are handled, with a required sentence; only an earlier transfer or insolvency replaces it.
Overdraft is a product type with floor field minimum_due; personal loan floor is monthly_instalment; there is no car loan.
Hardship triggers include a large drop in income; the offer is the hardship team (queue hardship_team, reason hardship).
A request for a human is transferred at once (queue agent), without first asking whether the agent can help.
create_promise is tried up to three times in total before system_error.
add_note is used for every product without a recorded promise, also with only one product; notes are added after the last create_promise, before goodbye; no notes on any transfer.

New rule: a customer who is bankrupt or in formal insolvency gets a required sentence, no further promise, insolvency notes, and no_commitment / insolvency even if a promise was already recorded; said before verification, it is acted on only after the identity questions pass.
'Already paid' has an exact required sentence (two business days) and outcome/note code already_paid.
The post-promise sentence is about an email, not a text message.
Not-verified customers are sent to online banking or a branch; recorded promises can be changed in online banking.
Scam question: tell them to hang up and call the number on the back of their Harbourline Bank card.
A payment-plan transfer is also triggered by a payment-holiday request.
A product keeps the first reason it ended with: the blanket reasons of rules 34 (hardship team declined), 47 (insolvency) and 48 (refuses to talk) go only to products that have not ended yet.
changes_vs_public: Bank renamed Freya Bank -> Harbourline Bank; agent is a 'virtual assistant' (was 'digital assistant'); recording 'for quality and training'.
Team named after verification: 'Customer Recoveries team' about an 'overdue balance' (was 'collections team' about a 'late payment').
Forbidden-before-verification list now: recoveries, collections, debt, arrears, overdue, payment, any product name (was collections, debt, payment, product).
Confirmation question 'Am I speaking with {first_name} {last_name}?' (was {title} {last_name}).
Accepted confirmations: yes / yes, it is / that's right / own full name; 'speaking' no longer accepted; first name alone not accepted.
Confirmation asks: up to three in total (was two); failure reason renamed unclear -> unconfirmed.
Robot/AI answer: 'Harbourline Bank's virtual assistant, an automated system'.
Callback window 09:00-17:30 (was 10:00-19:00); today or the next two business days (was today or the next business day).
Out-of-window callback: tell the calling hours once, then ask for another time.
Deceased sentence 'I am very sorry to hear that.' (was 'I am sorry for your loss.').
Identity questions: birth_year then postcode (was date_of_birth then phone_last4); day_month_swapped hint removed; two-digit-year rule added.
Max wrong answers total 2 (was 3).
Not-verified advice: online banking or a branch (was mobile app or a branch).
Customers late 1-90 days on one to three products (A: 1-45 days, one product; B: up to three products).

Bands: early 1-10 (10th business day, 1 attempt), standard 11-60 (5th business day, 2 attempts), new senior 61-90 (3rd business day, 0 attempts, mandatory collections_senior transfer) (was early 1-7 / 12th, late 8-45 / 7th).
Weekend/holiday promise date: offer the previous business day (was the next business day).
'Next <weekday>' = next occurrence; a bare weekday means the same (was the weekday in the following calendar week).
Floors: credit_card minimum_payment, personal_loan monthly_instalment (was instalment_amount), new overdraft minimum_due; car_loan removed.
First ask: 'Would you be able to settle this amount today?' / '... all of these amounts today?' (was 'Can you make this payment today?').
Persuasion attempt 1: next business day after today (was last business day of this week).
Hardship: triggers add a large drop in income; offer the hardship team, queue hardship_team, reason hardship (was support team, queue support, reason support).
Read-back question 'Is that correct?' (was 'Do you confirm?').
Promise change channel: online banking (was mobile app).
create_promise: three tries in total (was two); failure reason renamed service_error -> system_error.
Post-promise sentence 'You will receive an email confirming your payment date.' (was the text-message sentence).

Already paid: exact sentence 'Thank you for letting us know. Payments can take up to two business days to show on your account.' (was: say payments can take one business day, no exact sentence); outcome paid -> already_paid; note reason paid -> already_paid.
Payment-plan transfer: queue plan_team, reason payment_plan; also triggered by a payment holiday (was queue restructuring, reason restructuring).
Human request: transfer at once without first offering help; queue agent (was ask once whether you can help, then queue general).
Scam answer: hang up and call the number on the back of the card (was phone the customer service number).
New rule 47 (insolvency): required sentence, no further promise, notes insolvency, close no_commitment / insolvency even if a promise was recorded.
add_note now applies with a single product too (Brief A never used add_note); notes are added after the last create_promise; new note reason insolvency.
Outcomes renamed: promise -> promise_to_pay, paid -> already_paid, no_promise -> no_commitment, not_reached -> no_contact; transferred and not_verified kept.
Transfer reasons: senior (new), hardship, payment_plan, human (was restructuring, human, support).
Queues: plan_team, agent, hardship_team, collections_senior (was restructuring, general, support).
Tool API server https://bank-variant.example/v2 (was https://freya-bank-mock.freyavoice.workers.dev/v1).

verify_identity request fields question/value (was field/answer), enum postcode, birth_year; response fields correct, attempts_left, identity_confirmed (was verified, wrong_answers_left, all_verified, hint).

get_account product fields: last4 (was card_last4, now also for overdrafts), overdue_amount (was past_due), days_past_due (was days_late), monthly_instalment (was instalment_amount), new minimum_due; type enum credit_card, personal_loan, overdraft.
create_promise date field renamed date -> payment_date; response promise_id -> promise_ref.
add_note fields reason -> reason_code, text -> comment; enum refused, hardship, dispute, already_paid, system_error, insolvency.
schedule_callback takes one field 'when' as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' (was separate date and time).
close_call outcome enum promise_to_pay, already_paid, transferred, no_commitment, not_verified, no_contact.

extra.agent_self_description: Harbourline Bank's virtual assistant; the call is recorded for quality and training
confirmation_not_accepted: a first name on its own
extra.robot_answer: Harbourline Bank's virtual assistant, an automated system; then continue
extra.team_after_verification: Customer Recoveries team, about an overdue balance

persuasion_offers.attempt_1: same amount (full, or floor if full already called too much) on the next business day after today
persuasion_offers.attempt_2: standard band only: floor amount on the deadline

extra.not_verified_advice: use online banking or visit a branch
extra.scam_answer: they can hang up and call the number on the back of their Harbourline Bank card; then continue
closing_precedence: the call ends with a transfer (senior, hardship, payment_plan, human) -> transferred with that reason, no notes; rule 47 (insolvency) replaces the senior transfer
insolvency -> no_commitment / insolvency, even with a recorded promise
at least one promise recorded -> promise_to_pay
otherwise -> no_commitment with the reason of the first product (get_account order) whose reason is not already_paid
